title: fd_dacout_rec
description: `fd_dacout_rec` is like `fd_dacout`, routing a mono signal—or a sum of cloned signals—to `dac~`, with additional `throw~` objects for recording. It is intended for use with `writesf~`; corresponding `catch~` objects must use symbols in the form `rec-index`, such as `rec-1` and `rec-2`.
